messages:
Alex C-S: heads-up — Acme Finance just opened an escalation. they say answers are mixing up product names and dates. sample below.

Jules (Support): can you paste the raw request/response?

Alex C-S: sure, here's the API call they used (curl) and the model output they received: 

Alex C-S: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rw-infer-2.4-fast","prompt":"List LedgerPro and Novaledger launch dates and top 3 features for each.","max_tokens":200}'
```

Alex C-S: Response (customer pasted):

Alex C-S: ```
LedgerPro — launched 2019. Top features: realtime reconciliation, cross-border routing, built-in payroll.
Novaledger — launched 2017. Top features: transaction analytics, payroll, partnership with LedgerCorp announced 2018.
```

Alex C-S: Note: Acme says LedgerPro actually launched 2017 and Novaledger launched 2019, and there is no LedgerCorp partnership.

Priya (ML): odd. we rolled the tokenization tweak to fastpath yesterday morning (deploy-bot confirmed). could be a case of entity pieces being recomposed wrong across cached prefixes.

Tom (Infra): deploy-bot log for rollout: `deploy-bot: rollout rw-runtime/tokenizer-v0.11 -> all fastpath nodes (2026-02-27T09:12:03Z)`

Jules (Support): customer also reported this only after ~20k requests, so might be triggered by certain prompt shapes or caching. asked them for a repro with a minimal prompt.

Alex C-S: they sent a smaller repro: prompt = "Give launch year and main features for LedgerPro." result: "LedgerPro — launched 2019..." (wrong).

Priya (ML): can you ask for their full call headers and model_id/routing? need model variant (fast vs stable) and whether they pinned model version. Also ask for the exact sequence length they used if possible.

Alex C-S: pinged, they replied: "model: rw-infer-2.4-fast, region: us-west1, routing: default, no version pin, SDK: python 1.8.2"

Tom (Infra): collecting kube logs for nodes that got tokenizer-v0.11. grabbing inference logs and kv-cache hit ratios for the customer's client IP.

Priya (ML): hypothesis: tokenizer change altered subword boundaries causing KV cache reuse with mismatched alignments -> earlier tokens might get reinterpreted during generation and merge entity pieces incorrectly. possible false associations (Novaledger/ LedgerCorp). need to repro locally with same tokenizer, same model weights, same seed.

Jules (Support): I asked Acme to run this exact test and attach response JSON (no redact):
Jules (Support): ```
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key='REDACTED')
resp = cli.generate(model='rw-infer-2.4-fast', prompt='Give launch year and main features for LedgerPro.', max_tokens=80, return_full_response=True)
print(resp)
```

Alex C-S: they ran it and attached the full JSON. sample snippet in thread.

Priya (ML): next steps from ML: reproduce locally + run ablation (tokenizer v0.10 vs v0.11), check KV cache boundary conditions, run on a stable (non-fast) variant to compare. also run targeted eval set with firm entity list.

Tom (Infra): infra will snapshot the fastpath nodes with tokenizer-v0.11 and retain logs. if we confirm, we can rollback tokenizer on fastpath while we investigate.

Jules (Support): action item for support: collect 5 unique prompts from Acme that trigger the wrong dates/names, and the exact response JSONs (headers + model_id). asked them to share correlation to their traffic (timestamps).

Alex C-S: Acme flagged this as P2 and asked for ETA. told them we are investigating and will update in 4 hours.

Priya (ML): assigning to priya -> I'll try repro now. if I can reproduce, I'll open an internal bug and link eval examples + AB test results.

Priya (ML): quick note — if this is KV cache alignment, logs should show repeated cache hits where prompt prefix boundary changes at tokenization. I'll add instrumentation to log token IDs around entity tokens.

Tom (Infra): rolling back is option B. will wait for ML repro before triggering rollback. keeping a snapshot ready.

deploy-bot: `rollout job tokenizer-v0.11 on fastpath nodes completed at 2026-02-27T09:12:03Z`

Jules (Support): adding this to the incident tracker: INC-2026-241. tagging ML and infra.

Alex C-S: thanks team. i'll post updates from the customer here when they reply. :thumbsup:
